## Highlights
### New
- New Simple crests (Crest, Moon, Summit, Lens, Spark and Grove) sit beside the Heraldic ones when you choose a Space's icon, and new Spaces start in the Crest look. - Setup now ends with Make It Home, where you can make Crest your default browser and choose its search and how much ad blocking blocks.
### Improved
- Crest has a fresh look: a new three-banner mark, warm paper surfaces, Crest blue for actions, and bold rounded headings across setup, Settings and the Start Page. - The app icon and each alternative icon now follow your system's light, dark, tinted and clear icon styles, and sit at the right size in the Dock. - Setup opens on a full welcome, then lays its steps on a sheet of paper beside a live preview of Crest, with the steps as colored chips you can tap to go straight to one. - On iPhone, and on iPad held upright, setup walks the same steps as on a Mac: each Space's page wears that Space's colors, Preview shows it as Crest will, and the buttons float over the page. - The Space picker shows your Spaces in a well with a clear selector, a lighter mark for Sub-Spaces, and corners that follow your Corner radius setting. - Settings shows solid icons in Crest's colors. - Spaces brought in from another browser keep their own icon, set on a round crest in the Space's color.
### Fixed
- Finishing setup now responds the moment you tap Start Browsing and moves into Crest in one smooth motion, without a pause, a flash or a late page. - A new window that opens on Getting Started or Settings shows it at once instead of after a blank pause. - Search engine icons in pickers are now sized to their name, with clear room between the two.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
